name: How long does grout sealing last?

mainEntity.name: How long does grout sealing last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a grout seal typically ranges from 1 to 15 years, depending heavily on the type of sealant used and the environment. Standard topical sealants might last 1-3 years, while high-quality penetrating sealants can last 5-15 years or even longer. Factors like foot traffic, cleaning frequency and methods, and exposure to harsh chemicals or moisture (e.g., in showers) will all affect longevity. Regular maintenance and using pH-neutral cleaners can help extend the life of your sealed grout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout sealing can last 1 to 15 years, depending on the sealant type, traffic, cleaning, and moisture exposure. High-quality penetrating sealants offer longer durability.
